repair_unavailable_reason: A seed's PPR run fails on budget exhaustion or cancellation over a large memory graph. No flag bounds the walk, and the suggestions are still ranked by their other signals.

trigger.description: `ee graph suggest-links` seeds one FrankenNetworkX personalized PageRank run per candidate endpoint (up to 64). A run that exceeds the graph algorithm budget or is cancelled is counted instead of dropped: its candidate pairs carry a PPR signal of 0, and Adamic-Adar, tag overlap, retrieval affinity and preferential attachment still rank them. Reproducing it needs a memory graph large enough to exhaust the foreground budget.
